rationale: Downside momentum has stalled over the past 57 minutes, with the last five 1-minute candles forming a tight base at the $13.52 session low and curling back up to $13.55, putting price directly against the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.56). Reaching the $13.45 take-profit within the final 26 minutes of the session would require nearly 4x the current 5-minute ATR ($0.0247) in fresh downside expansion, which is low probability given the lack of follow-through. Closing now locks in the $10.59 unrealized gain before late-day short covering or a 9-EMA reclaim erodes the profit.
